assertions.assertion: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring was performed with CPT code 93229
The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor
The symptoms were of a non-sustained nature
There was a need for extended rhythm correlation
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period
The service was reasonable and necessary for the documented diagnoses I49.9 and R00.2
